feature: Per-role model defaults in distributable harness config
problem: The spike research established which model tier optimizes each harness role (planner=balanced, evaluator=reasoning, builder=user_controlled), but no distributable config exists. Practitioners who want per-role routing have no single source of truth, no documented override path, and no sync-local distribution for the routing config. Both planner.md and evaluator.md have model:inherit with no documentation of what that means or how to override it.
proposed_solution: 1. Create library/cursor/harness-model-routing.json as the single source of truth for role-to-model-tier mapping, rationale, and override path. 2. Add distribution of this file via make sync-local (one cp line in Makefile). 3. Add 'Role model routing' section to AGENTS.md documenting the three-step override path. 4. Do NOT change model:inherit defaults in agent files — distributable safety is the priority. Opt-in overrides are documented, not forced.
acceptance_criteria: library/cursor/harness-model-routing.json exists and is valid JSON with a 'roles' key containing planner, builder, evaluator entries each with default_model, recommended_override, rationale fields: python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('library/cursor/harness-model-routing.json')); r=m['roles']; assert all(k in r for k in ['planner','builder','evaluator']); assert all('default_model' in r[k] and 'recommended_override' in r[k] and 'rationale' in r[k] for k in r); print('PASS-AC1')"
make sync-local distributes harness-model-routing.json to .cursor/: grep -c 'harness-model-routing.json' Makefile && echo PASS-AC2
AGENTS.md contains a 'Role model routing' section with the override path documented (frontmatter file, sync step, model field): grep -c 'Role model routing' AGENTS.md && echo PASS-AC3

library/cursor/agents/planner.md and evaluator.md still have model: inherit (distributable defaults unchanged): python3 -c "open('library/cursor/agents/planner.md').read().index('model: inherit'); open('library/cursor/agents/evaluator.md').read().index('model: inherit'); print('PASS-AC4')"
make sync-local runs without errors and .cursor/harness-model-routing.json exists after sync: make sync-local && test -f .cursor/harness-model-routing.json && echo PASS-AC5
edge_cases: harness-model-routing.json must not hardcode volatile frontier model IDs (gpt-5.5, claude-*) as default_model values — defaults must be 'inherit' or stable tier names; overrides may reference model IDs as examples only

AGENTS.md section must reference both the .cursor/agents/ path (where consumers edit) AND the library/cursor/agents/ path (team default) — omitting either creates a gap in the override path documentation
make sync-local already removes .cursor/hooks/.commit-approved — verify the new cp line does not break the existing sync sequence (add it before the Done echo, after the existing cp lines)
verification_method:
Run from repo root:

python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('library/cursor/harness-model-routing.json')); r=m['roles']; assert all(k in r for k in ['planner','builder','evaluator']); assert all('default_model' in r[k] and 'recommended_override' in r[k] and 'rationale' in r[k] for k in r); print('PASS-AC1')"
# AC2: Makefile has sync line
grep -c 'harness-model-routing.json' Makefile && echo PASS-AC2
# AC3: AGENTS.md has section
grep -c 'Role model routing' AGENTS.md && echo PASS-AC3
# AC4: agent defaults unchanged
python3 -c "open('library/cursor/agents/planner.md').read().index('model: inherit'); open('library/cursor/agents/evaluator.md').read().index('model: inherit'); print('PASS-AC4')"
# AC5: sync works end-to-end
make sync-local && test -f .cursor/harness-model-routing.json && echo PASS-AC5
